summary: Crypto is attempting to form a floor after a sharp monthly decline, with Bitcoin near $60,000 and some analysts viewing the weakness as driven more by Nasdaq and AI-bubble risk than crypto-specific deterioration.[1][2][3] Gold is strongly rebounding, while Brent crude is under pressure amid surplus concerns despite geopolitical upside risks.[1][3] Coverage for several requested tokens and named analysts was not available in the retrieved results, so those signals are marked neutral rather than inferred.
